title: Remove List and Tree MCP Tools Except Main Tree
prompt: Remove all list and tree MCP tools from the semio-repo CLI/MCP server, keeping only the main `tree` tool. This consolidates the API surface by removing redundant granular list/tree tools that are superseded by the unified tree command.
